title: IR effects
note: What each instruction writes, runs, and may panic on. The verifier's self-tests pin the facts; error, container, cycle, and value tests see their behavior.

title: IR access
note: The one storage model: which storage an instruction touches. The verifier's self-tests and the error and value tests exercise it.

title: Conversions
note: Implicit and explicit conversions. TypeSelfTests checks the properties on random types; error and value tests print the conversions a program uses.

title: Place paths
note: How a place is decomposed into a base and steps. The verifier's self-tests build places; the error and reference tests use them.

title: Emitter: types
note: C++ declarations from the bound program. Class, struct, and value tests exercise the shapes it prints.

title: Emitter: bodies
note: Printing lowered bodies. Basics and lambda tests cover control flow; containers and value tests cover releases, operators, and formatting.
